name: Tower of London
description: The royal fortress where Richard II, his mother, and senior officials sheltered as the rebels entered London. Overrun on 14 June 1381 by a rebel force of roughly 400 that met no resistance at the gates; Archbishop Sudbury, Treasurer Hales, sergeant John Legge, and Gaunt's physician William Appleton were found inside and taken to Tower Hill for summary execution. Henry of Bolingbroke was discovered and nearly killed before a royal guard intervened; the Princess of Wales and Richard's half-sister were found, mocked, but released unharmed.
